description: SHA-256 of the compact, key-sorted JSON of each map of the canonical sets (in-maps, out-maps and the viseme pose bridge), of each signal record those maps read or write without its metadata, and of each evidence record that their mappings or those signals cite, in the B pack of the latest passing A/B freeze, ab.pivot v1. tests/test_pivot_structure.py checks that the pack keeps every one of them byte for byte.
